purpose: Consolidate settled research-design dimensions and request only a bounded native-path implementation/offline verification and manifest-preparation contract. Do not treat this proposal or an offline pass as real-model evidence.

panel_limits.original_gpt55_and_legacy_claude5_reques: Preserved unresolved; not silently substituted or declared globally unavailable. This preparation targets only the separately discussed five-family panel.

selected_pilot_design.comparison_scope: Proposer representation exposure within the same hard-validated game; not presence versus absence of all system ontology, and not game authoring.
claims_not_allowed: Cross-quest population inference from one task cluster
Model-only causal effects without native-context/tool parity evidence
Measured zero cost or proven cost advantage

requested_preparation_work: Implement the missing native proposal paths for the selected Codex/Claude Code/Antigravity designs through the existing typed prompt_runner boundary, without invoking real providers. Preserve current unauthorized-native rejection; do not bypass offline provenance by labeling native runs offline.

Freeze one existing eligible quest, the public-minimal input/source manifest, semantic facts and representation renderings, independent goal/safety oracle evidence and a deterministic 20-row assignment plan. Distinguish a plan from assigned or executed scientific rows. Stop and report if existing evidence cannot establish eligibility or publicity.

Verify local request construction/response parsing, identity/effort/fallback/context evidence handling, before-launch authorization rejection, host/repair/deadline accounting and no-commit-on-invalid/late output using engineering fixtures and disposable local Godot/process checks.

Preserve full proposal/evidence/validation/repair/commit/replay records and unknown usage/billing fields honestly. Produce a source-hash-bound readiness report with exact commands and unresolved activation gates.

allowed_local_changes.existing_affected_tests: Locate actual references before any changes; keep existing offline behavior and run only new/modified coverage.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: A missing, false, expired or source-mismatched native activation/public-input/identity-setting/subscription-only prerequisite blocks before provider process creation. Existing offline CLI still refuses --live; a new native mode must not relabel execution as synthetic/offline.

Each of the three native host contracts has real production request/response handling grounded in captured help/types or current official docs and tested only against clearly labeled engineering transports. No paid API fallback, silent model/host substitution or unrestricted context/tool access.

Every observable host attempt, including malformed/refused/timeout/corrective/transport-retry attempts, counts toward12; logical repairs stay at most2 per decision; requests use min(60s, remaining180s). Late/invalid output cannot commit. Verify local subprocess timeout/cleanup boundaries without claiming remote cancellation or billing stop.

The 20-row plan has1 quest/5 design families/2 matched-information representations/2 fresh repeats, deterministic recorded order/seed and resets. Independent hard validation and engine-observed goal/safety/replay remain authoritative. Plan rows, fixture runs and assigned scientific episodes are distinct.

Bind exact public-eligible inputs, schema/prompt/game/ontology/source and oracle hashes. Account/auth/wiki/raw-conversation/repository-wide or unverified-public input is excluded; lack of publicity evidence is an unresolved gate, not permission to transmit.

Do not invent provider identity/revision/effective effort/token/price/remaining quota. Verifiable existing-subscription/no-additional-charge evidence is mandatory for later execution; unknown or additional-charge exposure blocks. Any provider-reported cost estimate remains distinct from actual subscription billing.

Keep npc_goal.py, existing1.1.0 controller/schema and earlier immutable decisions/endpoint/publication artifacts unchanged. Reuse the existing engine/prompt-runner seams; preserve offline positive/negative behavior and assigned-denominator/error evidence.

Return exact focused command/fixture/Godot/replay evidence and a source-bound readiness result. Offline success is engineering evidence only: no actual account lookup, prompt transmission, model generation, additional billing, scientific episode, publication, push or deploy occurs.

approval_binding: Any approval must reference this exact proposal and digest and is for local native-path preparation only. Final source-bound research activation and a launch decision remain separate.
